d:
Desi Melodies presents the much-awaited music video of the title track from BPraak's debut album, ‘Zohrajabeen’ now in 8K. Every frame directed by Arvindr Khaira is a tribute to BPraak’s supreme voice, music, and composition along with Jaani’s transcendent words that are elevated by the enigmatic presence of Bollywood legend, Randeep Hooda, and the radiant Priyanka Chahar Choudhary.
Singer and Music - B Praak
Lyricist - Jaani
Composer - B Praak
Featuring- Randeep Hooda, Priyanka Chahar Choudhary, Bhavaya Chawla
Director - Arvindr Khaira
